sentences.text:
Ahin Roychoudhury vs State Of West Bengal & Anr on 20 April,
2023
Author: Bibek Chaudhuri

Bench: Bibek Chaudhuri
20.04.2023 Sl. No.24.
D/L. Mithun.
Ct.No.42.
Crr/940/2023
Ahin Roychoudhury Vs. State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Ayan Bhattacharjee Adv.

Mr. Subhajit Manna, Adv.
Mr. Suman Majumder, Adv.
...for the petitioner.

On the basis of a written complaint dated 10 th November, 2022 police registered Rampurhat Police Station Case No.578 of 2022 dated 10th November, 2022 under Sections 498A/323/325/307/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
Petitioner is the husband of the de-facto complainant.
It is found from the FIR that there marriage was solemnized on 7 th February, 2022 and after few months of marriage, she was subjected to physical and mental torture.
On 14 th October, 2022, the petitioner and his parents assaulted the petitioner with throttling.
The de-facto complainant somehow managed to save herself taking shelter to another room closing the door from inside.
She narrated the incident to her mother over her mobile phone.
She was medically treated on 14 th October, 2022 at Ranaghat Sub-Divisional Hospital.
In the instant application the petitioner has not collected any injury report of opposite party No.2 from Ranaghat Sub-Divisional Hospital.
Without perusal of the said medical examination report, it is not possible for the Court to come to a finding as to whether the petitioner attempted to commit murder of the opposite party No.2.
For proper appreciation of the instant revision, case diary should be looked into.
Accordingly, the instant revision be admitted.

The petitioner is directed to serve notice upon the private opposite party under registered speed post with acknowledgment due and file affidavit of service within three weeks from the date of this order.
